facts.value: Triple Bachelor in Economics and Business (EUTribe)

The European Triple-Bachelor in Economics and Business (EU Tribe) is a unique educational experience where students study in three major European cities, at three renowned universities, and receive degrees from all three participating universities.
Students spend the first year in Frankfurt, followed by one year in Brussels and another year in Rome.
The studies in Brussels and Rome can be completed entirely in English.
Possibility to acquire or improve Italian and French language skills.
Interested students apply initially for the Bachelor program in Economics at Goethe University. In the first semester, they apply for the Triple-Bachelor program.
Application for the Triple-Bachelor program occurs in the first semester.
The foreign study phase begins in the third semester.
Good to very good academic performance and English language skills at B2 level are required for admission to the Triple-Bachelor program.
The program is supported by scholarships under the Erasmus+ program for a maximum of one academic year (260 days).
Tuition fees are waived for participating students at both partner universities.
